brief.headline: AEGIS Overwatch review fixes shipped; JARVIS command HUD deployed.

items.text: AEGIS OVERWATCH demo hardened: pinch ghost-tap guard, theme-complete compass/grid/feed, JAGM/RIFLE brevity, texture cache.
QA pass: city additive blowout fixed, sat-uplink feed brightened, real elevations, longer impact FX.
JARVIS personal command HUD built and deployed — voice loop, orb, panels, agent roster, state pipeline.
Sentinel repo is not attached to this workspace yet — add it with add_repo so the team can execute, not just plan.

priorities.label: SENTINEL DEVELOPMENT
priorities.next: Attach Sentinel repo → chief of staff maps codebase → sentinel-lead proposes next milestone plan.

tasks.title: Attach Sentinel repo to JARVIS workspace
tasks.note: Say “add repo <owner/name>” in Claude Code; sentinel-lead takes it from there.

tasks.title: Sentinel: map codebase + write milestone plan
AEGIS: record 2-min cinematic capture for the pitch
Configure ElevenLabs key for authentic JARVIS voice
tasks.note: Settings panel → key + voice ID. Falls back to en-GB system voice.

tasks.title: Load values.md + business.md knowledge base
tasks.note: jarvis/knowledge/ — the team checks decisions against it.

roadblocks.title: Sentinel source not in workspace
roadblocks.impact: P0 priority can be planned but not executed.
roadblocks.proposed: Attach the Sentinel repo to this Claude Code environment (add_repo), then fire the sentinel-lead agent.

roadblocks.title: No ElevenLabs credentials
roadblocks.impact: JARVIS speaks with the system en-GB voice instead of the cinematic one.
roadblocks.proposed: Paste key + voice ID in Settings (stored in this browser only).

roadblocks.title: Mic permissions on headset browsers
roadblocks.impact: Wake-word listening may be unavailable on some Meta browsers.
roadblocks.proposed: Use tap-to-talk on the orb, or the typed command line — both drive the same intents.

demos.title: AEGIS OVERWATCH
demos.desc: Holo-tactical command table — Denver Front Range theater, sat-uplink window, 4 Lockheed asset packages, cinematic mode.

demos.title: JARVIS COMMAND HUD
demos.desc: This interface. Voice loop, reactive orb, popup panels, agent state pipeline.

agents.name: CHIEF OF STAFF
agents.role: Runs every session: reads state, delivers the brief, routes work to the team, updates state before signing off.

agents.name: SENTINEL LEAD
agents.role: Owns Priority One. Maps the Sentinel codebase, plans milestones, ships development work.

agents.name: DEMO ENGINEER
agents.role: Owns the demos group — AEGIS Overwatch and future concept pieces. Polish, QA, cinematic capture.

agents.name: BRIEFING OFFICER
agents.role: Compiles what changed since you left into brief.items and the spoken morning brief.

agents.name: BIZ OPS
agents.role: Business problems and roadblocks: triage, propose solutions, flag what needs your call.
